name: std::localeconv
intro: The localeconv function obtains a pointer to a static object of type std::lconv, which represents numeric and monetary formatting rules of the current C locale.

sections.title: Return value
sections.text: Pointer to the current std::lconv object.

sections.title: Notes
sections.text:
Modifying the object references through the returned pointer is undefined behavior.

std::localeconv modifies a static object, calling it from different threads without synchronization is undefined behavior.
